card.name: Numbers in radiation dose tables
card.fires_on: The first digit of a number, or a slash, right before a unit such as mCi, mSv, mGy, MBq or mg. It appears mostly in radiation dosimetry tables and exposure comparisons.

modes.label: Digit before dose unit
modes.description: A leading digit of a value directly followed by a radiation or dose unit.

modes.label: Slash in unit pairs
modes.description: The slash inside a combined unit like mSv/MBq in effective dose rows.

modes.label: Threshold values
modes.description: A digit starting a limit or cutoff in lab or safety text.

card.plain: It lights up on the start of a number or the slash in a unit within radiation dose tables.
